dedupe_keys.name: organogram and staff pay data for directly operated railways

description: Organogram and staff pay data for Directly Operated Railways is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Directly Operated Railways Limited. Organisation structure charts (organograms) for Directly Operated Railways. Providing: 1. structure of the department/body down to directorate level 2. positions of all Senior Civil Servant (SCS) Pay Band 2 and above (or equivalent) 3. names of SCS Pay Band 2 and above 4. salaries of all Pay Band 2 and above 5. Coverage: United Kingdom. The portal files it under the publisher Directly Operated Railways Limited. It offers 4 resource(s) in CSV, PDF. The portal shows 2026-07-03 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is UK Open Government Licence (OGL). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
